en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a bridge over a river, with a wrought-iron fence in the foreground. In the background, there is a prominent hill with a large fortress or castle atop it, and a church with an onion dome tower. There are several classic European buildings visible, one of which has the sign 'Jos. Sobel.' There are handwritten inscriptions on the lower part of the postcard and some printed text in German along the left and bottom edges.
